description: This Java class 'CompatibilityConfig' is a Spring configuration component responsible for setting up HikariCP database connection pooling based on environment variables, while also issuing deprecation warnings about older configuration methods. It uses annotations for configuration, dependency injection, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: CompatibilityConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up HikariCP DataSource with environment-driven configuration and deprecation warnings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: PostConstruct method that logs a warning about deprecated configuration and suggests environment variable updates.

methods.name: hikariTenantDataSource
methods.description: Creates and provides a configured HikariDataSource bean with a lifecycle destroy method.

methods.name: hikariConfig
methods.description: Constructs and configures a HikariConfig object based on environment variables.

methods.name: dataSourceProperties
methods.description: Defines and returns a set of JDBC connection properties for the data source.
